children: K+S - REDUCES FINANCIAL LIABILITIES BY €150 MILLION THROUGH SUCCESSFUL BOND REPURCHASE
K+S - ACCEPTED FOR REPURCHASE NOTES WITH AN AGGREGATE PRINCIPAL AMOUNT OF €150 MILLION (30% OF THE OUTSTANDING NOTES)
K+S - VALIDLY TENDERED NOTES WERE ACCEPTED ON A PRO RATA BASIS APPLYING A SCALING FACTOR OF 85.15%
K+S - REPURCHASE PRICE UNDER THE OFFER WAS AT 101.473%, PLUS ACCRUED INTEREST
K+S - SETTLEMENT OF THE TRANSACTION IS EXPECTED TO TAKE PLACE ON SEPTEMBER 11, 2026
K+S - NOTES REPURCHASED BY K+S WILL BE CANCELLED AND WILL NOT BE REISSUED
